DuoAero 1.4.0 is an intermediate original-runtime preview, not the completed 2.0 release.

This build includes additional word-first formula exercises, longer named-quantity cards, course and progress changes, a revised first-midterm question bank, seven introductory second-midterm lessons and additional character artwork. Some new range and taper lessons remain research drafts and are not included in the path.

Android diagnostics exercised local formula controls and a seeded synthetic lesson with persisted progress and restart. Full course coverage, all requested character animations, all formula layouts, real Google/Drive accounts and a physical S24 Ultra remain unverified. Long exercises and an emulator memory-growth issue remain under investigation. The original updater channel and permanent signing certificate are retained.
